confidence_notes: Holistic July 2026 estimate from general knowledge of Bucharest price levels; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Beer and restaurant anchors are more reliable than July accommodation rates, which vary with demand and lead time, so hostel and hotel figures carry the widest range. Cocktail and wine_glass were cross-checked against the beer anchor because direct knowledge of them is weaker. USD values rest on approximate RON-to-USD levels, not a sourced rate. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries of RBA pages rather than a direct read of the RBA table, and the 14 October entry was not independently confirmed; verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Central and Eastern European EU capitals with similar price levels, such as Sofia, Budapest and Krakow, adjusted to Bucharest's local restaurant and hotel ranges.
